canonical_project: Yotta Chennai Data Center Park, Singaperumal-Oragadam highway
notes: Yotta announced an MoU with the Government of Tamil Nadu to build a data center park on a 13-acre campus at Hiranandani Parks on the Singaperumal-Oragadam highway, with four data center buildings, 20,000 racks and approximately 150-240 MW total power load. Because the site lies in the Chennai suburban corridor around Singaperumal Koil/Oragadam, it is assigned to Chengalpattu district for this batch; later public build status was not confirmed.
